Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1257 West Fry Street, Chicago, TL

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 4,410 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with a new
four-story residential building containing four (4) dwelling units and a
detached garage. The proposed building will measure 47 ft. in height. The
subject property is a Transit Served Location and will be supported by four
(4) off-street parking spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs, 17-13-
1003-EE and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the
Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking ratio for a Transit
Served Location to 100% (four (4)) parking spaces for four (4) residential
units), reduce the front setback from 15 feet to 8 ft., and is seeking all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 7,496 square feet (1.7 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,102.5 square feet per D.U.
(4 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 4 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Chicago Bus
Route), Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
required number of off-street parking spaces from two (2) parking spaces (50%) to
four (4) parking spaces (100%).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 8 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 3 feet
West Side: 3 feet-8 inches
c. Rear Setback: 36 feet

(E) Building Height: 47 feet
